title: Sandy Koufax Bobblehead, Time Warner Dodger Stadium Promo - New

descriptionText:
This limited edition Danbury Mint Sandy Koufax Bubble Head Time Warner Cable Promotion is a must-have for any Dodger Stadium fan. Celebrate your love for baseball and the Major League (MLB) with this unique collectible item. Featuring the legendary player Sandy Koufax, this bubble head is a true gem for any fan.

Represent your team with pride and add this Sandy Koufax Bubble Head to your collection of baseball memorabilia. Perfect for display or as a thoughtful gift, this item is sure to impress any true baseball fan. Don't miss out on the chance to own a piece of history.
